Please provide a precise location and evidence. A general statement such as "the proof is wrong" without an identifiable step or supporting evidence cannot be investigated.

## Exact location
Release/tag, manuscript version, theorem/lemma/section/equation, archive filename and SHA-256, and member path or line:

## Claim and evidence
Quote the precise disputed claim and give the missing hypothesis, counterexample or derivation. Explain its effect on the stated finite-dimensional/projective tensor scope.

## Authority and impact
Is this in a canonical proof, a validation record, or historical/rejected material? Identify any dependency affected. Separate a reproducible calculation from a rigorous interval-certification objection.
